# Free AI Index

> Free AI Index is an evidence-led directory of free, trial, downloadable and low-cost AI offers, with official sources, validity terms, setup commands and direct registration or download links.

## Primary pages

- [Free AI Index](https://freellm.top/) — the full catalog of free, trial, promotional and open-weight AI offers
- [Free-LLM Guide](https://freellm.top/guides/free-llm/) — 免费 AI 与 LLM API 开放目录指南

## Models

- [Model directory (all models)](https://freellm.top/models/all/) — 完整模型大列表，逐行标注中国大陆可用性（可用 / 不可用 / 待核验），附各提供商注册要求（手机号、实名、信用卡）/ continuous model catalog with per-row mainland-China availability labels and per-provider signup requirements
- [Model center](https://freellm.top/models/center/) — 精选免费资源 + 完整模型目录与大陆可用性筛选 / featured offers plus the full model directory with the mainland-CN availability filter
- [Providers](https://freellm.top/providers/) — 模型提供商目录 / model providers with counts and access guides
- [国内免费 AI API](https://freellm.top/guides/china-free-ai-api/) — 面向中国大陆用户的免费 AI API 指南 / free AI APIs for users in China

## Categories

- [Free AI coding IDEs](https://freellm.top/category/free-ide/) — coding IDEs with recurring free quotas or provider-defined free modes
- [Free AI quota](https://freellm.top/category/free-quota/) — APIs and services with recurring free usage quotas
- [AI API services](https://freellm.top/category/api/) — free-tier and low-cost LLM and search APIs
- [AI trials and promotions](https://freellm.top/category/promo/) — one-time trials and first-month promotions, renewal prices shown when known
- [Student AI offers](https://freellm.top/category/student/) — offers requiring student verification
- [Web and browser AI tools](https://freellm.top/category/web/) — search, scrape and browser-automation APIs with free tiers
- [Open-weight AI models](https://freellm.top/category/open-weights/) — open-weight models with official model cards and copyable download commands

## Trust rules

- "Free" is always qualified: free quota, trial, promotion, free IDE mode or open weights.
- A free model download does not mean free GPU, storage, inference or network egress.
- Offers can change by region, account type, provider policy and time window.
- Official provider sources are linked from each offer; verify the current terms before subscribing.
